capabilities: Search verses, themes, outlines and notes in Chinese Bibles
Read multiple Bible versions side by side
Project selections fullscreen in verse, parallel or mixed modes
Expand Recovery Version notes and chain links inline
Detect Bible references in notes and open verse popups
extras: Built-in Bible data (~25 MB JSON) lives in the plugin folder and updates separately from the plugin code; a first-run wizard downloads missing versions. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Bible text, so users cannot search, compare or project Chinese Bible versions inside their vault.

relations.evidence: O / P：交给 Hymns 插件，分别是诗歌全屏投影 / 诗歌窗口投影

summary: Bible search, reading and projection plugin for multiple Chinese versions, with inline notes, comparison and group-study modes.
